Commentary.Commentary: Liyanage though glued himself on one end. He batted right till the end and along with the tail made sure Sri Lanka end with a competitive score. If not for him, the innings would have been closed well long ago. For Bangladesh, they bowled well throughout. Rishad Hossain got a wicket on the first ball but gave too many freebies. Other than that, Bangladesh bowled well. Right then! 235 looks a chaseable total but the pitch isn't that straightforward to bat. There is some swing and the spinners are getting purchase too. The series is on the line. Who do you think will win? Stay tuned for the chase.

An entertaining innings comes to an end. Janith Liyanage's excellent century has been overshadowed by a number of injuries on the other side. Anamul Haque, Jaker Ali, Soumya Sarkar and Mustafizur Rahman all got injured at different times. Mustafizur Rahman and Jaker Ali went off on stretcher. However, talking about the game it was one of the best innings you will see under pressure. Liyanage played brilliantly. He kept on losing wickets regularly. Kusal Mendis, Sadeera Samarawickrama and Charith Asalanka got off to a good start but gave away their wicket.
OUT! RUN OUT! Outside off. Lahiru Kumara slashes it to long off. The batters look for a couple but the fielder throws and Lahiru Kumara is well short for his second. Sri Lanka end with 235 runs.

Hello and welcome to the third and final ODI between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. It’s time for the decider. The series has been lively so far and it boils down to the final match.
